title: APE prompt optimizer
description: UserPromptSubmit hook that reframes a raw prompt before Claude acts. Thin local triage injects the spec only when a rewrite is warranted. Fails open.

hooks.name: ape
hooks.why: Optional APE prompt optimizer. Triages each prompt locally and injects the transformation spec only when a rewrite is warranted. Fails open. Disable per-prompt with a leading '!ape' or 'sans ape'.

notes: APE prompt optimizer enabled. Disable per-prompt with a leading '!ape' or 'sans ape'.
